name: mcpp-emit-unavailable
description: A project whose .xlings.json asks for an mcpp that is not installed, simulated by mcppls-mock-mcpp: xlings answers every mcpp command with its own explanation and runs nothing. The status carries that explanation instead of a bare failure, sources are scanned meanwhile, and nothing is written into the project.

checks.issue-message: mcpp could not describe the project: [warn] mcpp@2026.8.7.1 is the version this project asks for, and it is not installed yet
